methodology.isolation: One fresh process per scenario/library; jobs run sequentially in seeded shuffled order; one default warmup, three default measured samples with the same seed; optional GC between iterations; imports, oracle arrays and GC outside timing
methodology.timing: Includes pipeline construction, timer waits, output validation, instrumentation, and cleanup; excludes process startup; cancellation next() settlement and iterator.closed measured separately from actual abort time
methodology.memory: runtimeApi records process.memoryUsage() with runtime/version and per-field accounting status; missing fields are null; Bun external/arrayBuffers accounting is unverified, not zero usage; OS ps RSS is observed before workload and after cleanup outside timing, not simultaneously with API readings and not as a peak; process.memoryUsage() sampled every sampleMs and once after cleanup; independent peak for each field, not a simultaneous snapshot or guaranteed upper bound; event-loop delays can miss peaks; process RSS/heap includes runtime, library and instrumentation; preallocated oracle arrays scale with input count and are included in baseline; no memory ceiling or leak proof
methodology.bounds: maxActive counts active attempts; retries retain stage slots between attempts; maxAhead = yielded inputs minus sink receipts; maxReady = successful attempts minus sink receipts; logical bounds asserted per transition, not heap limits; includes at most one item handed to sink
methodology.comparison: Ordered delayed/slow-sink/retry only, same lazy async numeric source, payload, timer function, concurrency, capacity/backpressure, validation and sink; retry is one retry after 2 ms, failing every fifth ID only on attempt 1; p-map uses a matching callback wrapper; cancellation and unordered/rate have no library ranking
methodology.rate: rateLimit counts source next() including final done; admission is bracketed by downstream request and source observation; the oracle rejects windows that violate the limit even with observation delays; strict observed window maxima are reported separately
methodology.statistics: Every sample plus median/min/max; host-specific synthetic timers, not network/storage I/O; no confidence interval or causal queue comparison
